newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Five firms eye stake in Meralco.
newsitem.headline: Five firms eye stake in Meralco.

text.p: Manila Electric Co (Meralco), the country's biggest power utility, said on Tuesday five firms had expressed interest in acquiring its shares.
Interested buyers include Electricite de France, Morgan Stanley, Jardine Fleming and two U.S.-based firms, Meralco president Manuel Lopez told stockholders in their annual meeting.
"They (the firms) have sounded us out but I told them to go to the Presidential Commission on Good Government (PCGG)," Lopez said.
The PCGG is the custodian of all sequestered assets of former strongman Ferdinand Marcos and his business associates.
The Commission had expressed its intention to sell some Meralco shares.
PCGG officials have said in previous interviews the government holds about 30 percent of Meralco.
